audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..4].side read 'Skill' while win[0..4] and packet.levelChart both read 'Annie'. Five rows rendered two different answers to who wins the stage.
audit.why: 44.13% over 358 games is the worst rate in this slice; Annie spawns with Pyromania available, so her stun is live at level 1 and stays live every four casts.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved to Annie on rows 0-4 with every why rewritten to argue that verdict, ratings dropped to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 row claimed you win every 2v2 with R on a row the chart gives to Annie.
audit.why: Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100 at 600 range and lands on a stocked stun; Emperor's Divide is 120/105/90 and is a reaction, not an opener.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row now states her 600-range ult on a stocked stun and tells you to hold R for it; ahead/carry keyed to the 130s Tibbers cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never explained how Pyromania is charged, only that it exists. Nothing gave the range numbers that decide the standoff.
audit.why: Riot: 'After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target. Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.' Disintegrate is 4s and 625 range, Incinerate 7s and 600, Tibbers 600 — your soldier attacks cover 525 from a soldier placed up to 525 away, so the fight is decided by whether you are inside 625 when the fourth cast lands.
audit.corrected: Written into tldr, enemyWin, phases[0].why, phases[2].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Disintegrate 4s, Incinerate 7s, Tibbers 130s at rank 1, your E 19s at rank 3, plus an explicit restock window after the stun goes off.

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells' — a candidate interaction with soldier attacks.
audit.why: Whether Molten Shield's retaliation applies to Azir himself when a Sand Soldier attacks her is not in Riot's text and not in the kit file.
audit.corrected: Left off the page rather than guessed. Recorded in notes.
